purpose: Physical access props for mini-games, card decks, worlds, dungeons and other KFB destinations; inspired by keystone/key access logic but not a second currency or hidden entitlement system.
persistenceConcept: Session / Journey / Fractal Almanac + bounded Backpack state

requestedPresentationVariants.note: Treat as presentation/access-tier concept until a source-backed silver material/palette or separate donor is visually proven.
Treat as presentation/access-tier concept until a source-backed gold material/palette or separate donor is visually proven.

accessRefs: mini-game | card-deck | world | dungeon | portal | event | scene
AccessPropItem.optionalTier: presentation/access tier only; semantics belong to receiving game owner
AccessPropItem.optionalInstanceSeed: for future dungeon/world variant binding if a host needs it

proposedRules: Access truth belongs to the receiving mini-game/world/dungeon/deck owner; the prop carries/refers to that grant but does not own destination runtime.
Physical key/keycard should remain visible and inspectable rather than becoming an invisible unlock flag whenever practical.
The Almanac records where/how the access prop was acquired and used.
Keyrings are presentation/grouping devices; they must not duplicate grant truth.
Gold/silver must not be claimed as separate KayKit key source files until visually/source proven.
Access props may later be gifted/found/rewarded, but transfer semantics are a product choice per prop.
inspirationNote: Borrow the readable physical-access-token idea from Mythic/keystone-style dungeon access, not its exact difficulty/economy system.
